nodes.summary: Package barrel and design doc for the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol integration, describing both directions: exposing this agent as an A2A server and acting as a client to peer agents via JSON-RPC over HTTP/SSE.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the LangGraph-based core agent, documenting the hand-built ReAct state graph (agent node + tools node) chosen over create_react_agent to retain full control of the custom multi-protocol LLM abstraction.

nodes.name: cancel_registry.py
nodes.summary: Cooperative cancellation registry mapping thread_id to asyncio.Event, letting clients interrupt in-flight streaming generation without brute-cancelling LangGraph's internal tasks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses cooperative cancellation (Event flags) instead of asyncio.Task.cancel() because LangGraph's astream manages its own tasks internally.

nodes.summary: Empty package barrel marking the agent nodes subpackage (agent_node, tools_node implementations live in sibling modules).

nodes.summary: Package barrel documenting JWT authentication: bcrypt password hashing, token issue/verify, request-scoped user/tenant context, and an auth_enabled switch that degrades to a default user for dev.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for core infrastructure: configuration, logging, exceptions, and dependency injection.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel describing unified lifecycle management for four databases via a db_manager singleton, with lazy connections and non-fatal failures so individual DBs can be toggled per environment.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for Hermes self-evolution: passive memory/profile learning after each turn and active reflection-based prompt self-optimization, both async, versioned (rollbackable), and disable-able.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package barrel for the LLM provider implementations subpackage.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel documenting MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration in both directions: a client that pulls external MCP server tools into the agent, and a server that exposes built-in tools to other agents via FastMCP.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the memory system: short-term thread state via LangGraph checkpointer (MemorySaver for dev, PostgresSaver for production) and long-term cross-session store.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for HTTP middleware, currently providing Redis sliding-window rate limiting with hooks for request logging and CORS.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the user-profile system built on Neo4j, modeling entities and relationships as a graph for efficient multi-hop queries, with an in-memory dict fallback when Neo4j is unavailable.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the RAG knowledge base: document upload, chunking, embedding, and semantic retrieval that reuses the existing PostgresStore/InMemoryStore index with namespace isolation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the business service layer between API routes and agent orchestration, centralizing session management, auth, permissions, and tenant isolation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the Skill system: a declarative capability unit (metadata + tools + prompt fragment) that can be loaded on demand, with tools sourced from @tool decorators or MCP.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: User-facing README for the Self-Agent CLI client covering installation, the slash-command set, AGENT_API_URL configuration, and the NDJSON streaming transport rationale versus the web client's SSE.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Hatchling package manifest for selfagent-cli declaring the httpx/rich/prompt_toolkit dependencies, the selfagent console-script entry point (selfagent_cli.main:main), and the dependency on the main self-agent package for local in-process mode.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Top-level package barrel for the Self-Agent CLI client, exposing the package version.

nodes.name: local.py
nodes.summary: Local-mode bootstrap that runs the agent in-process (no HTTP backend): presets environment variables before any app module imports, registers tools by risk tier, loads skills, and warms the compiled LangGraph. The architectural alternative to the server form factor.
nodes.languageNotes: All app.* imports are deferred inside functions so environment variables can be set before the lru_cached get_settings() runs and freezes configuration.

nodes.name: localrepl.py
nodes.summary: Interactive local REPL loop that drives the in-process agent: streams tokens live via rich, fully consumes each event stream (so LangGraph persists interrupt state), and closes the approval loop inline by feeding resume_agent the user's gating decision.
nodes.languageNotes: Nested async consumer with a nonlocal closure; critically must NOT break out of astream on approval_required or the checkpointer never records the interrupt and resume silently fails.

nodes.name: render.py
nodes.summary: Terminal rendering for agent events: renders approval prompts (surfacing command/path/risk so a user can judge in one second), task-plan panels, and non-token event types using rich.

nodes.name: register_stream
nodes.summary: Registers a streaming thread under its thread_id and returns a fresh asyncio.Event used as its cooperative cancel flag.

nodes.name: request_cancel
nodes.summary: Signals cancellation for a registered thread_id by setting its event; returns whether the thread was found.

nodes.name: bootstrap
nodes.summary: Resolves the workspace root and presets local-mode environment defaults (sqlite storage, coding tools on, auth/multi-tenant/A2A/MCP off, raised recursion limit) using setdefault so explicit user config wins; must run before any app.* import.

nodes.name: setup_agent
nodes.summary: Initializes the local agent: registers read/write/shell/plan tool sets by risk, optionally loads skills, pre-warms the compiled graph, and returns a capability overview (workspace, storage, sandbox, tools) for the CLI banner.

nodes.name: LocalSession
nodes.summary: Per-session REPL state holding the thread_id, the set of tools the user authorized as 'always allow' this session, and the current task plan.

nodes.name: _drive
nodes.summary: Runs one conversational turn: consumes the full stream_agent event stream (rendering tokens live), and if an approval_required event appears, asks the user and feeds the decision back via resume_agent, looping until no pending approval remains.

nodes.name: run_local_repl
nodes.summary: Main local REPL entry point: prints the banner, reads input in a loop, dispatches slash-commands, and drives a conversational turn per non-command line with KeyboardInterrupt/exception handling.

nodes.name: _handle_local_command
nodes.summary: Slash-command dispatcher for the local REPL handling /new, /plan, /tools, /info, /trust, /help, /exit.

nodes.name: render_approval
nodes.summary: Displays an approval request as a risk-colored panel highlighting the tool, risk level, and key arguments (shell command or file path/diff), then reads the user's approve/deny/always decision.

nodes.name: render_plan
nodes.summary: Renders the task plan as a status-icon panel (completed/in_progress/pending) with a done-count header.

nodes.name: render_event
nodes.summary: Renders a non-token agent event (tool_calls, tool_start, tool_result, tool_denied, error, cancelled, plan_updated) as concise terminal status lines.
